items.originalTitle: Generative AI-Enabled Mission-Aware Radio Orchestration for RIS-Assisted LEO Satellite ISAC Systems
items.summary: 针对任务自适应的LEO卫星ISAC网络，开发了生成式AI无线电编排框架，用LLM将任务映射为结构化策略，结合确定性验证和物理层优化实现波束、功率和RIS配置。混合时间尺度设计在任务时间尺度用生成式AI进行语义适应，在信道时间尺度保留传统无线优化。零样本和上下文学习在未知任务上的优先级准确率分别为91.7%和94.4%。
items.abstract: Mission-adaptive low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellite networks with integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) must retarget radio resources as operator goals change. To enable this adaptation from flexible operator language, we develop a generative-AI-enabled radio-orchestration framework in which a large language model (LLM) maps each mission into a structured policy comprising communication, sensing, and fairness weights, mandatory quality-of-service thresholds, power-allocation guidance, and solver initialization…
keyFacts: 如何利用生成式AI将灵活的任务语言转化为可执行策略，并实现LEO卫星ISAC系统的无线电资源编排？
提出生成式AI赋能的无线电编排框架：LLM将任务映射为结构化策略，包括通信、感知和公平性权重，强制性QoS阈值，功率分配指导和求解器初始化；确定性验证和物理层优化确保可行性；采用混合时间尺度设计，并进行LLM-ZS和LLM-ICL对比。
在未见指令上，LLM-ZS和LLM-ICL的优先级顺序准确率分别达到91.7%和94.4%，ICL主要改善数值校准，下游无线电性能差异统计上不显著。显式交替优化直接优化活动波束和RIS相位时保持定性排序。

items.title: 行星预测引擎：通过智能数据选择和基础模型嵌入实现自主地理空间预测
items.originalTitle: Planetary Prediction Engine: Autonomous Geospatial Prediction via Intelligent Data Selection and Foundation Model Embeddings
items.summary: 提出行星预测引擎(PPE)，一个从自然语言查询直接执行端到端工作流的自主AI系统，实时合成多模态数据集，检索时空相关协变量并融合地理空间基础模型嵌入，同时搜索任务定制的模型架构。在多项任务中优于现有方法，如美国空间回归改进平均R²，尼日利亚粮食安全指标R²翻倍，埃博拉预测召回率提升。
items.abstract: Addressing critical global challenges, from food security and disaster risk to disease outbreaks and socio-economic vulnerability, demands high-fidelity geospatial modeling. However, building predictive planetary models remains bottlenecked by a fragmented data ecosystem, requiring manual data retrieval, multimodal data curation and fusion along with iterative model selection. We present the Planetary Prediction Engine (PPE), an autonomous AI system that executes this end-to-end workflow directly from natural-lang…
keyFacts: 如何自动化地理空间预测的端到端流程，克服数据碎片化、手动检索和模型选择瓶颈？
PPE系统：根据自然语言查询实时检索和融合多模态数据（来自Data Commons、Google Earth Engine等），使用地理空间基础模型嵌入（PDFM、AlphaEarth），并自动搜索任务定制的模型架构，带自动过拟合防护。
PPE在多个任务上优于现有技术：美国21项CDC健康指标平均R²从60.0%提升至76.8%；FEMA风险指数从60.0%至64.9%；社会脆弱指数从58.6%至66.2%；尼日利亚粮食安全R²从31.5%翻倍至66.1%；埃博拉预测召回率83.3%，比公共先进模型提高10.3个百分点。

items.title: AsymSpec：面向智能体LLM的上下文非对称投机解码
items.originalTitle: AsymSpec: Context-Asymmetric Speculative Decoding for Agentic LLMs
items.summary: 提出AsymSpec非对称投机解码框架，打破起草者与验证者必须共享相同上下文的对称性：轻量级起草者读取完整输入，大型验证者操作压缩视图。通过对比δ融合和发散感知接受门控，在四种智能体能力和两个端到端基准上，达到约90%全上下文准确率，同时实现1.3-1.7倍吞吐量提升和0.2-0.3倍计算成本。
items.abstract: Agentic LLM pipelines face escalating inference costs as context accumulates across retrieval, tool use, and multi-turn interactions. To control latency, deployments routinely compress inputs, but this degrades task accuracy. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates generation losslessly, yet it assumes the drafter and verifier share an identical context, preventing SD from resolving the accuracy-overhead trade-off. We propose AsymSpec, an asymmetric speculative decoding framework that breaks this symmetry: a lightwe…
keyFacts: 如何在不牺牲准确率的情况下解决智能体LLM推理中压缩输入带来的精度下降和延迟成本问题？
提出AsymSpec框架：起草者使用完整上下文，验证者使用压缩视图；通过对比δ融合调制逻辑，并采用发散感知接受门控以保持验证稳定性和高接受率。
在四种智能体能力和两个端到端基准上，AsymSpec平均达到约90%的全上下文准确率，在孤立文本能力上实现1.3-1.7倍吞吐量提升和0.2-0.3倍计算成本。上下文非对称访问在压缩丢弃关键推理信号时带来显著收益。

items.abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflows have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving complex, open-ended tasks through collaborative reasoning among specialized LLM agents, but they incur substantial operating costs due to repeated LLM invocations and long-horizon context accumulation. Existing cascade routing methods make one-shot, query-level decisions and cannot adapt to the dynamic, state-dependent nature of multi-step workflows, in which the right LLM at each step depends on evolving task progress…
keyFacts: 如何为多步多智能体LLM工作流做出在线逐步行路由决策，以在质量和成本之间取得权衡？
ProgRouter包含多视图进度评分器、双路径进度预测器和自适应元门控机制，在线做出平衡进度增益、时间预算和运营成本的逐步行路由决策。

items.summary: 本文提出EASEL基准，评估参考引导的视觉重建任务中的灵巧视觉工具使用。包含语义任务和440k样本的课程数据集EASEL-Data，以及模型EASEL-9B。评估25个模型发现，当前多模态智能体在此任务上表现困难，重建相似度低，闭环不稳定。EASEL-9B相对基础模型提升6.3%，排名第三。
items.abstract: Evaluation is shifting from static QA toward agentic settings where models act through external tools. Most models, however, fix in advance which behavioral variables interact and how. Behavior outside that form is absorbed as noise, while models flexible enough to capture it tend to lose interpretability. items.originalTitle: SonicNudge: Controlled Displacement of Hovering UAVs via Estimator-Controller Coupling
items.summary: 本文介绍SonicNudge，一种针对陀螺仪的新型攻击原语，通过超声波共振引起的小陀螺仪扰动可转化为悬停或慢速移动UAV的受控位移。该攻击利用估计器-控制器耦合，在PX4风格飞行栈中分析，并通过81次仿真和10多次室内外物理实验验证，位移受估计器权重、偏差可观测性和闭环位置修正影响。
items.abstract: UAV displacement attacks have traditionally relied on spoofing sensors that directly report position or translational motion, such as GNSS and optical flow. In this work, we introduce SonicNudge, a new attack primitive that instead targets the gyroscope and shows that low-level inertial errors can be transformed into controlled displacement of hovering or slow-moving UAVs. The attack exploits estimator--controller coupling: a small gyroscope perturbation by ultrasonic resonance can persist as an attitude-estimatio…
keyFacts: 如何仅通过攻击陀螺仪的低层惯性误差来实现悬停或慢速移动无人机的受控位移？
利用估计器-控制器耦合，通过超声波共振产生小陀螺仪扰动，并在PX4风格飞行栈中分析，结合仿真和物理实验验证。

items.originalTitle: Adversarial Training of Linear Models under Stealthy Attacks

提出基于检测器的切换模型，推导线性预测模型对抗风险的凸公式，并引入攻击概率超参数。
